title: Eval harness: add prompt-set regression CI gates and metrics integrations
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: catch regressions to prompt-set quality early in CI by running a lightweight eval harness as a gate and surface a stable set of metrics to the PR UI. This PR adds a new CI workflow, eval harness integrations, and quality-gating logic. Changes include: 1) a new GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/eval-gate.yml) that runs a curated prompt-set suite against the target model variant and fails the job when configured thresholds are breached; 2) an eval-harness plugin that computes and normalizes key metrics (BLEU/ROUGE-style scores, exact-match on structured-output tasks, hallucination rate, and a composite quality_score); 3) a CLI flag and API hook to run the lightweight suite locally (tools/eval/run_prompt_gate --model <id> --thresholds config/eval/prompt_gates.yaml); 4) integration with PR checks to post a summary comment and artifact links (artifacts include JSON with per-prompt metrics and a small CSV for quick diffing); 5) docs and a short migration guide for teams to opt-in and tune thresholds. Security/Performance notes: the CI job runs on a small sample (~50 prompts) with caching of tokenized prompts and uses a reduced-precision model binary when available to bound cost. Backwards compatibility: gating is opt-in via repo-level config at .github/eval_gates.yaml. See ENG-924 and ENG-947 for product context. Checklist: - [x] add workflow and action - [x] implement metric normalization and composite score - [x] add PR commenter and artifact upload - [x] docs and migration guide - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] validate on staging models
